content:
General
* This is too easy as a puzzle. It'd be better to re-create it as a clash of code.

Goal
* Please remove '"Order List: None" and "Total Price: 0 PHP"'. Instead, display them on separate new lines as {{constants}}:
{{Order List: None
Total Price: 0 PHP}}

* Please remove the entire Best Sellers Menu. Since all the relevant food items for each case are already provided in the input, including the menu in the Goal section is unnecessary and may be confusing.

Input
* The current description explains the output rather than the input. Please revise it so that it accurately describes the input.

Output
* Please format "None" as a {{constant}} and remove the quotation marks.

Constraints
* Please add constraints for each input variable.

Tags
* Please remove all tags except "Strings". (This point will become irrelevant when the contribution is re-created as a clash of code.)

Cases
* Test 1 is the same as Validator 1. Please revise the validator (e.g. by reordering the food items) so that the cases are similar but different.

Thanks.

Hello everyone,
 
This is my second contribution, following my first successful project: Budget Tracker from the Clash of Code game. First of all, I want to thank you all for the amazing support you gave for my very first contribution — it really meant a lot!
 
For List It: this is a classic puzzle where you can learn and practice working with arrays/lists,  trim() ,  parseInt() , and how to store and process data while keeping the original information intact.
 
This idea was inspired by my own cravings 😆 and the delicious delicacies here in the Philippines. I hope you guys enjoy solving it and find it helpful for learning. Please feel free to share your feedback and suggestions — thank you so much for your time and continued support!
